1.

To look up and see Thee there, O Lord, what joy! To contemplate Thy great love, Its breadth and depth and height!

2.

To confess the power of Thy blood, Which flowed for us all, And weary hearts to revive With the thought of God’s Lamb!

3.

What joy it is to see the path Which Thou didst so humbly tread, To learn to walk in Thy grace And be led by Thy gaze.

4.

To look forward to that day, When Thou Thyself shalt appear, When we Thy lovely countenance With unclouded gaze shall see!
